adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Group#addMembers` and `Group#removeMember` in `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, both returning `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` with no rejection handling (`catch`/`fail`) and no user-facing error path. The controller actions in `admin-group.js.es6` (`addMembers`, `removeMember`) similarly just call these methods (after `bootbox.confirm` for removal) and do not disable the add/remove UI while the request is in flight, so repeated clicks can issue duplicate PUT/DELETEs. This is a concrete robustness/UX concern grounded in the new flow, but it’s not a strictly verifiable correctness defect from the diff alone (server-side may be idempotent, and failures just result in no feedback).
